ar017_events.note: verified only when the trigger condition actually fired (untriggered = neutral, never refutes); the policy records only successful re-captures, so a positive count means the trigger condition actually fired; MFF_B and MFF_C are judged independently (independent instances by construction)

ledger.normalization: ops <= c*((L+1)*serial_events + (L+N)*batched_events) per sidecar generation; L = num_hidden_layers, N = 4

meta.a5_scheme_a_note: warmup pre-capture amortization holds under the bench protocol (every timed rep replays each window's runners); in single-shot production generation the capture amortizes NEGATIVE (one capture ~= 2-3 forwards serving a single replay) -- recommend use_cuda_graph=False for single-shot generate scenarios
meta.canary_note: the no-fallback canary checks the DEGRADATION class only (timed segment == 0): every non-structural graph-path eager fallback; structural eager (window-populate, window-switch, last-window no-AR) is counted separately and excluded by design (else the canary is constructively false)
meta.forced_divergent_declaration: the sampler pins a per-(T, prompt_len) forced base tensor whose True positions cover exactly the active block; every folded forward (denoise iterations, the block-advance AR step, and the [N,T] batched verification) threads it through ManualFoldedForward(forced_divergent=...); the freshly committed / actively denoised region is always recomputed, never gate-certified stable against a stale parent
meta.gpu_driver_version_note: queried via nvidia-smi; null means the query failed on this host and the value was omitted rather than fabricated
meta.greedy_anchor_declaration: candidate row 0 = the greedy hypothesis: every still-masked position is filled with the draft top-k ordered-set head (the frozen argmax definition; deterministic construction, zero device readback, no generator); N semantics frozen: total candidates = config N, greedy occupies row 0, random candidates = N-1 (j = 1..N-1, the frozen seed formula keeps j as the row number, so rows 1..N-1 match a greedy-off same-seed run inside the canvas-consistent region -- the first speculative small block); branch_ids keep their AR021 row-number semantics (_cand0 names the greedy row); min-prob selection is unchanged -- the greedy row competes with no exemption or weighting and may lose
meta.h4_scope_note: the aligned-mode batched capture/replay sub-criterion is verified on every shape window with >= 1 batched call in the sidecar generation (the AR021 H4 criterion applied to MFF_C); the degradation canary and the c=4 ledger bound cover ALL THREE folded modes; AR017 events are verified only when triggered (untriggered = neutral), MFF_B and MFF_C judged independently
meta.interleaving: per-rep round-robin over the four modes; rep r starts at position r%4 (anti-drift, WDDM fairness)
meta.kernel_count_note: runtime CUPTI probe: this torch build cannot record CUDA profiler events (LIBKINETO_NOCUPTI); kernel-launch counts recorded null + note, never fabricated (#39) - the write_op_count ledger and graph_pool_stats counters are the structural evidence
meta.ledger_normalization: per publish event: a serial forward publishes 1 event counting L+1 ops (<= 4*(L+1), trivially in bound); a batched publish counts O(L+N) ops (put_batch foreach groups + immediate executions, <= 4*(L+N)); the aggregate over a generation preserves the bounds (AR020-style, c frozen at design); verified on the untimed sidecar generation (same deterministic trajectory as the timed reps)

folded-batched.description: FR3 batched speculative block verification (N=4 from the AR019 artifact matrix, candidate_top_k=10, A5 scheme a); AR017 adaptive capacity engaged on the batched path only (#37); split_layers=False on all three MFF instances (Split-layer resident hooks would stack on the shared model)

folded-batched-greedy.description: AR022 alignment mode: MFF_C, an independent instance constructed identically to MFF_B (own cache/gate/pool/canary/AR017 policy -- per-mode isolation for H4) with candidate_include_greedy=True (row 0 = greedy hypothesis); same [N,T] batched shape, N, top-k, prompt set, and seed as folded-batched -- the speed variable is constructively zeroed (same-shape A/B)

folded-serial.description: FR2 serial chain folding (#26) with the pinned fold-context trio and the shape-keyed serial pool

meta.platform_note: Windows WDDM display-driver mode (no clock locking); noise mitigated by warmup + reps + p50 + per-rep round-robin

prompts.prepad_note: prompts pre-padded to exact 32-token multiples (pad=eos) so the sampler's own first-block padding is zero and the pinned fold-context mask is the pure block-causal mask, element-equal to the remote model's internal eval_mask (the raw path's [B,T] mask is overwritten internally by the remote forward); non-zero padding would break cross-mode parity by construction
texts: Explain the key ideas of the theory of relativity in a few short sentences for a general audience.

meta.reproduction_selfcheck_declaration: the folded-batched sidecar quality face (same seed, deterministic trajectory, warmup-post replay pool state) is compared for STRICT equality against the AR021 artifact priors (quality.h3_batched_vs_baseline: block_exact_match 0.0/0.0, len_other 160/77, posthoc_mean 0.289692/0.106418, posthoc_min 5e-06/0.0); on mismatch the artifact records reproduction_anomaly and ALL FOUR H verdicts are set to 'blocked' (the same-environment determinism assumption failed wholesale; no single-face verdict is trustworthy; never silently substituted, never fabricated); the check binds same-GPU/driver/venv reruns (RERUN_CHECKLIST scope) -- a different host failing equality is recorded blocked honestly; under --quick the face degrades to a structural validation (single prompt / num_tokens=64 cannot reproduce the full-scale priors) and does not gate
meta.shape_keyed_pool_declaration: graph_runner_pool_size=8 per MFF instance: one runner per (tokens shape, pinned mask identity) window == (T, prompt_len) serial / (N, T, prompt_len) batched; expected entries <= 8 per pool (W*P upper bound; folded-batched and folded-batched-greedy: serial (W-1)*P, batched W*P; folded-serial <= W*P data-dependent), zero evictions at cap=8 (LRU is a defensive bound only); MFF_A/B/C are independent instances, so their pools are fully isolated
meta.sigma_convention: sigma = max(sigma_a, sigma_b) bound to the mode pair; H2 (greedy vs batched) uses sigma = max(sigma_greedy, sigma_batched) with the directional no-regression rule (supported iff p50(batched) - p50(greedy) >= -2*sigma; no inconclusive); quality faces are deterministic single-shot sidecar measurements with no sigma; samples pooled over prompts x reps per mode
meta.single_run_discipline: the full (reps=30) run is a pre-committed single-shot verdict, no rerun fishing (#39 continuation); this artifact is the --quick smoke run (separate path, never the formal artifact) and its H verdicts are non-final
meta.timing_method: host perf_counter + torch.cuda.synchronize (#39); whole-generation wall clock plus per-block anchors (the forward wrappers observe the step_idx change as the block boundary; syncs only at those boundaries)
meta.vram_note: three MFF instances (MFF_A/B/C) are resident for the whole run, so every mode's peak includes all three pools; the design estimate was ~5.8GB + interaction margin <= 6.5GB on a 16GB card (AR021 folded-batched peak 5374.5MB + one MFF_C-shaped increment ~427MB); the measured peaks above are the honest calibration
meta.warmup_strategy: one full discarded sample per (mode, prompt) before any timing, all four modes: per-shape-window pool pre-capture (A5 scheme a: the warmup round naturally captures every window's serial and batched runners, MFF_A/B/C alike) + Triton/JIT warmup + the AR017 adaptive transition; capture costs are excluded from p50 (srs FR4); timed-segment re-captures, if any, are counted and timed honestly

folded-batched.semantics: captures_cumulative: instance lifetime (warmup + sidecar + timed, H4 capture criterion); replays_timed / *_timed: diff from the post-warmup snapshot (sidecar included in the snapshot base); evictions: cumulative

folded-batched-greedy.semantics: captures_cumulative: instance lifetime (warmup + sidecar + timed, H4 capture criterion); replays_timed / *_timed: diff from the post-warmup snapshot (sidecar included in the snapshot base); evictions: cumulative

folded-serial.semantics: captures_cumulative: instance lifetime (warmup + sidecar + timed, H4 capture criterion); replays_timed / *_timed: diff from the post-warmup snapshot (sidecar included in the snapshot base); evictions: cumulative
